item.title: ai: Build once, reuse across your agent fleet: Tools and Toolboxes in Foundry
item.description:
The post introduces Tools and Toolboxes in Foundry as a way to share agent capabilities across multiple production agents instead of wiring the same integrations separately for each one. It focuses on reducing duplicated instructions, dependencies, and setup work when scaling agent fleets.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog
